scrapers.name: AIOStreams
scrapers.description: Debrid-backed torrent streams from a configured AIOStreams instance, resolved from tmdbId via a TMDB external_ids lookup (AIOStreams itself is keyed on IMDb id). Replaces Torrentio, which this used to run. Authenticates with a UUID/password baked into providers/aiostreams.js. Retries once on a transient failure or empty result. AIOStreams request timeout raised to 25s (from 8s) -- its /search endpoint aggregates multiple indexers server-side and was being aborted on slower networks before a legitimate, working response arrived.
scrapers.author: Ported from the English Stremio addon's aiostreams.js
